Since then, I’ve seen a major improvement on my mood & stress. Of course, it hasn’t cured my depression, but it gives me a fighting chance. Challenge myself l makes everything else seem manageable for the most part. Now I’m able to work out, even when I don’t want too.

What started out with physical goals, turned into a complete mindset change on mental well being. With that, came the physical changes, even when I wasn’t focused on them. It’s extremely hard for me to lose weight because of my depression/anxiety meds, so progress has been slow
